title: Egg white protein-polyphenol-pullulan complexes: Structural characterization and application in high freeze-thaw stability high internal phase emulsions.
authors: Bi, Jiahui; Liu, Lan; Gao, Xin; Yang, Fuming; Chi, Yujie; Chi, Yuan
one_liner_zh: 该研究构建蛋清蛋白-多酚-普鲁兰三元复合物并表征其稳定高内相乳液的冻融稳定性，虽用分子对接分析蛋白-多酚互作，但对象为食品蛋白复合物而非无序蛋白/IDR，且无PPI机制建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: High internal phase emulsions (HIPEs) are highly susceptible to structural deterioration during freeze-thaw cycles. In this study, egg white protein (EWP)-polyphenol-pullulan ternary complexes were constructed using proanthocyanidins (PC), gallic acid (GA), and tannic acid (TA) to enhance the freeze-thaw stability of HIPEs. SDS-PAGE and molecular docking analyses demonstrated synergistic covalent and noncovalent interactions between polyphenols and EWP. Formation of ternary complexes significantly reduced particle size (33.30-63.60%), increased surface charge density, and improved colloidal stability. A transition from spherical to lamellar microstructures and enhanced hydrophilicity were observed. HIPEs stabilized by the ternary complexes exhibited outstanding freeze-thaw stability (93.78-97.47%), while retaining high viscosity and well-developed rheological networks after cycling. Interfacial characterization revealed dense and rigid interfacial films, leading to smaller and more uniform droplets without phase separation. DSC analysis further confirmed superior freeze resistance through reduced crystallization temperatures. These results provide an effective strategy for designing freeze-stable HIPE systems.
abstract_zh: 高内相乳液（HIPEs）在冻融循环过程中极易发生结构劣化。本研究利用原花青素（PC）、没食子酸（GA）和单宁酸（TA）构建蛋清蛋白（EWP）-多酚-普鲁兰多糖三元复合物，以增强HIPEs的冻融稳定性。SDS-PAGE和分子对接分析表明，多酚与EWP之间存在协同共价和非共价相互作用。三元复合物的形成显著减小了粒径（33.30-63.60%），增加了表面电荷密度，并改善了胶体稳定性。观察到从球形到层状微结构的转变以及亲水性的增强。由三元复合物稳定的HIPEs表现出优异的冻融稳定性（93.78-97.47%），同时在循环后保持高粘度和完善的流变网络。界面表征揭示了致密且刚性的界面膜，导致液滴更小且更均匀，无相分离现象。DSC分析进一步通过降低结晶温度证实了优异的抗冻性能。这些结果为设计冻融稳定的HIPE系统提供了有效策略。
